Equation 5:
\upmu=\upmu_{m a x}\frac{S}{K_{S}+S+\left(\frac{S^{2}}{K_{i}}\right)}

Symbols (as printed -> plain name to use):
  \mu  ->  mu   (Specific growth rate.)
  S  ->  S_   (Concentration of the growth limiting substrate.)
  K_{S}  ->  KS   (Half velocity constant, i.e., substrate concentration at half of the maximum growth rate.)
  K_{i}  ->  Ki   (Substrate inhibition coefficient.)
  \mu_{max}  ->  mumax   (Maximum specific growth rate.)
